subject: Harpy Hall
fact: A large chamber with high ceilings and rafters thirty-four feet up, where the party fought harpies and ghouls. The harpies positioned themselves in the air to sing their charming songs.
source_quote: A large chamber with high ceilings and rafters thirty-four feet up, where the party fought harpies and ghouls. The harpies positioned themselves in the air to sing their charming songs.

subject: Southern Room (Harpy Nesting Area)
fact: A foul-smelling room reeking of carrion and filth, with bones littering the floor and heaps of old cloth along the walls indicating where harpies once nested. Old garments hang from pegs on the wall, and elven chain mail was discovered here.
source_quote: A foul-smelling room reeking of carrion and filth, with bones littering the floor and heaps of old cloth along the walls indicating where harpies once nested. Old garments hang from pegs on the wall, and elven chain mail was discovered here.

subject: Abandoned Room with Broken Chest
fact: A noisome place littered with rags and bones, featuring a broken chest in the northwest corner that contained treasure. A door to the west is located near the west corner.
source_quote: A noisome place littered with rags and bones, featuring a broken chest in the northwest corner that contained treasure. A door to the west is located near the west corner.

subject: Antechamber of a Minor Functionary
fact: An inner room with plastered walls covered in obscene paintings, containing the remains of upholstered furnishings including a couch and four chairs. Battered pewter dishes are heaped upon a small table. This is where the party encountered two ghasts who claimed the territory as their own.
source_quote: An inner room with plastered walls covered in obscene paintings, containing the remains of upholstered furnishings including a couch and four chairs. Battered pewter dishes are heaped upon a small table. This is where the party encountered two ghasts who claimed the territory as their own.

subject: Romag's Office
fact: The place where Romag conducts his business for the Earth Temple. The party reports their progress here and discusses their future within the temple hierarchy.
source_quote: The place where Romag conducts his business for the Earth Temple. The party reports their progress here and discusses their future within the temple hierarchy.

subject: Harpies
fact: Winged creatures that use enchanting songs to charm adventurers. They position themselves thirty-four feet up in the air and attack with claws. When their plans are thwarted, they become furious and swoop down to attack party members.
source_quote: Winged creatures that use enchanting songs to charm adventurers. They position themselves thirty-four feet up in the air and attack with claws. When their plans are thwarted, they become furious and swoop down to attack party members.

subject: Ghouls
fact: Undead creatures that attack with claws and bites, possessing the ability to paralyze their targets with a DC 10 constitution save. They have an armor class of twelve. Three initially emerged from a southern door, and four more later entered from the north. One ghoul initially focused on eating a dead harpy before joining combat.
source_quote: Undead creatures that attack with claws and bites, possessing the ability to paralyze their targets with a DC 10 constitution save. They have an armor class of twelve. Three initially emerged from a southern door, and four more later entered from the north. One ghoul initially focused on eating a dead harpy before joining combat.

subject: Calmer
fact: A cleric and party member who wields a mace of smiting and uses Sacred Flame in battle. He provides crucial healing during combat, restoring nineteen and twenty-three hit points to party members. He expresses discomfort and weariness with Zephyr's decisions and is deeply troubled by Romag's planned ritual involving prisoners.
source_quote: A cleric and party member who wields a mace of smiting and uses Sacred Flame in battle. He provides crucial healing during combat, restoring nineteen and twenty-three hit points to party members. He expresses discomfort and weariness with Zephyr's decisions and is deeply troubled by Romag's planned ritual involving prisoners.

subject: Ghasts
fact: Two territorial undead creatures encountered in an antechamber with obscene paintings. They claim to have seized the territory from a human or elf, demonstrating this by crunching on a gnawed bone. They feign allegiance to the Earth Temple when confronted by the party, though an insight check reveals they are merely playing along for their own benefit.
source_quote: Two territorial undead creatures encountered in an antechamber with obscene paintings. They claim to have seized the territory from a human or elf, demonstrating this by crunching on a gnawed bone. They feign allegiance to the Earth Temple when confronted by the party, though an insight check reveals they are merely playing along for their own benefit.

subject: Romag
fact: The leader of the Earth Temple who sits in his office looking very pleased with the party's territorial expansion. He delivers passionate tirades about the power of the earth crushing everything to dust. He operates on a system where the party brings treasure to the temple and pays him a portion rather than being paid directly. He proposes a loyalty ritual involving prisoners where bodies will be ripped apart, and instructs Harch to prepare for this ceremony.
source_quote: The leader of the Earth Temple who sits in his office looking very pleased with the party's territorial expansion. He delivers passionate tirades about the power of the earth crushing everything to dust. He operates on a system where the party brings treasure to the temple and pays him a portion rather than being paid directly. He proposes a loyalty ritual involving prisoners where bodies will be ripped apart, and instructs Harch to prepare for this ceremony.

subject: Harch
fact: An individual instructed by Romag to prepare prisoners for a loyalty ritual ceremony.
source_quote: An individual instructed by Romag to prepare prisoners for a loyalty ritual ceremony.

subject: Mace of Smiting
fact: A powerful magical mace wielded by Calmer, used effectively to strike at flying harpies as they attempt to escape. Calmer landed a critical hit with it, dealing ten points of damage to a harpy, and also dealt nine points of damage on another strike.
source_quote: A powerful magical mace wielded by Calmer, used effectively to strike at flying harpies as they attempt to escape. Calmer landed a critical hit with it, dealing ten points of damage to a harpy, and also dealt nine points of damage on another strike.

subject: Pistol
fact: A ranged weapon used by Zephyr, treated as an improved crossbow that deals 1d10 worth of damage rather than 1d6 points of damage. Zephyr used it to attack ghouls and shot it into the air to scare a harpy.
source_quote: A ranged weapon used by Zephyr, treated as an improved crossbow that deals 1d10 worth of damage rather than 1d6 points of damage. Zephyr used it to attack ghouls and shot it into the air to scare a harpy.

subject: Dagger
fact: A melee weapon used by Zephyr for close-quarters attacks and as a reaction weapon. He used it to strike a fleeing harpy, dealing six points of damage.
source_quote: A melee weapon used by Zephyr for close-quarters attacks and as a reaction weapon. He used it to strike a fleeing harpy, dealing six points of damage.

subject: Elven Chain Mail
fact: A piece of magical armor discovered hanging from pegs on the wall in the harpy nesting area. It provides a plus one bonus to armor class and allows the wearer to be considered trained with the armor even without proficiency in medium or heavy armor. The party decided to keep it in their inventory for potential sale since Calmer already has superior plate armor.
source_quote: A piece of magical armor discovered hanging from pegs on the wall in the harpy nesting area. It provides a plus one bonus to armor class and allows the wearer to be considered trained with the armor even without proficiency in medium or heavy armor. The party decided to keep it in their inventory for potential sale since Calmer already has superior plate armor.

subject: Gold Pieces
fact: Currency found in a broken chest. Thirty-seven gold pieces were discovered and distributed among the party, with some members receiving eight gold pieces and others receiving ten.
source_quote: Currency found in a broken chest. Thirty-seven gold pieces were discovered and distributed among the party, with some members receiving eight gold pieces and others receiving ten.

subject: Platinum Pieces
fact: Currency found in a broken chest. Seven platinum pieces were discovered and distributed among the party, with most members receiving two platinum pieces and one member receiving three.
source_quote: Currency found in a broken chest. Seven platinum pieces were discovered and distributed among the party, with most members receiving two platinum pieces and one member receiving three.

subject: Silver Pieces
fact: Currency found in a broken chest. Ninety-two silver pieces were discovered and distributed among the party.
source_quote: Currency found in a broken chest. Ninety-two silver pieces were discovered and distributed among the party.

subject: Copper Pieces
fact: Currency found in a broken chest. One hundred eight copper pieces were discovered and distributed among the party.
source_quote: Currency found in a broken chest. One hundred eight copper pieces were discovered and distributed among the party.

subject: Sacred Flame
fact: A divine spell used by Calmer to deal radiant damage to enemies. He used it against a ghoul, dealing nine points of damage, and against a harpy, dealing five points of damage. The targets must make a dexterity saving throw to avoid the damage.
source_quote: A divine spell used by Calmer to deal radiant damage to enemies. He used it against a ghoul, dealing nine points of damage, and against a harpy, dealing five points of damage. The targets must make a dexterity saving throw to avoid the damage.

subject: Sequioa's trap check on the broken chest
fact: Sequioa checks the chest for traps with a roll of twenty-eight and finds none.
source_quote: Sequioa checks the chest for traps with a roll of twenty-eight and finds none.

subject: Sequioa's stealth attempt to pocket treasure
fact: Sequioa opens the chest and attempts to use stealth to pocket extra treasure, rolling a twenty-six.
source_quote: Sequioa opens the chest and attempts to use stealth to pocket extra treasure, rolling a twenty-six.

subject: Zephyr's failed insight check on Sequioa
fact: Zephyr fails to notice Sequioa's deception with his insight check.
source_quote: Zephyr fails to notice Sequioa's deception with his insight check.

subject: Chest contents discovery
fact: The chest contains thirty-seven gold pieces, seven platinum pieces, ninety-two silver pieces, and one hundred eight copper pieces.
source_quote: The chest contains thirty-seven gold pieces, seven platinum pieces, ninety-two silver pieces, and one hundred eight copper pieces.

subject: Treasure distribution
fact: Sequioa distributes the treasure, giving himself and Zinnia a slightly larger share than Zephyr.
source_quote: Sequioa distributes the treasure, giving himself and Zinnia a slightly larger share than Zephyr.

subject: Party negotiates with ghasts
fact: The party encounters two ghasts in an antechamber and negotiates a temporary alliance under the guise of the Earth Temple.
source_quote: The party encounters two ghasts in an antechamber and negotiates a temporary alliance under the guise of the Earth Temple.

subject: Ghasts claim territory and demonstrate with bone
fact: The ghasts claim the territory as their own, stating they seized it from previous occupants. A ghast crunches on a gnawed bone and confirms it was human.
source_quote: The ghasts claim the territory as their own, stating they seized it from previous occupants. A ghast crunches on a gnawed bone and confirms it was human.

subject: Ghasts feign allegiance to Earth Temple
fact: The ghasts immediately declare allegiance to the Earth Temple, shouting 'Hail the Earth Temple!' An insight check reveals they are merely playing along for the moment.
source_quote: The ghasts immediately declare allegiance to the Earth Temple, shouting 'Hail the Earth Temple!' An insight check reveals they are merely playing along for the moment.

subject: Party reports to Romag
fact: The party returns to Romag to report their territorial gains, leading to discussions about payment and a planned loyalty ritual.
source_quote: The party returns to Romag to report their territorial gains, leading to discussions about payment and a planned loyalty ritual.

subject: Romag's tirade on earth's power
fact: Romag delivers a five-minute tirade about the power of the earth and how it crushes everything down to dust.
source_quote: Romag delivers a five-minute tirade about the power of the earth and how it crushes everything down to dust.

subject: Romag's payment system explanation
fact: Romag explains that the party is expected to bring treasure to the temple and pay him a portion, not the other way around.
source_quote: Romag explains that the party is expected to bring treasure to the temple and pay him a portion, not the other way around.

subject: Romag's loyalty ritual proposal
fact: Romag proposes a loyalty ritual involving prisoners where bodies will be ripped apart, and instructs Harch to prepare for this ceremony.
source_quote: Romag proposes a loyalty ritual involving prisoners where bodies will be ripped apart, and instructs Harch to prepare for this ceremony.

subject: Romag's clarification on prisoner use
fact: Romag clarifies that the party members are too valuable to be killed, and that prisoners will be used for the ritual instead.
source_quote: Romag clarifies that the party members are too valuable to be killed, and that prisoners will be used for the ritual instead.

subject: Party's contingency plan for missing prisoners
fact: The party confirms they planned to blame the Fire Temple for the missing prisoners.
source_quote: The party confirms they planned to blame the Fire Temple for the missing prisoners.

subject: Romag postpones ceremony
fact: Romag postpones the ceremony until tomorrow, instructing the party to rest.
source_quote: Romag postpones the ceremony until tomorrow, instructing the party to rest.
